review.notes: All 15 PDF pages word-compared with the OCR markdown; no code fences, 13 figure embeds present. One defect: reference [26] title word OCR-misread ("Onetworkla" for the printed "Onetwovla", verified on a 300 dpi render of physical p.10 which prints "Onetwovla: A unified vision-language-action model with adaptive reasoning. arXiv preprint arXiv:2505.11917"). Author affiliation superscripts, affiliation line, Figure 2 speech-bubble/architecture labels (SigLIP 400M, Gemma 4B, quoted instructions, pot masher), chart legends and axis ticks (75/100) are figure-internal or present in the markdown; reference-name tokens dropped on pp.10-11 are hyphenation splits already present unsplit in the markdown. Appendix math subscripts are LaTeX-equivalent.
